title: wardrik.evaluation.completed
description: A judge model answered, or failed to answer, questions about a tool call or a finished turn. Its span's parent is the tool call or step it judged.

answers.description: Each question's answer by its name, such as {"probability": 0.72} for a yes-or-no question.

cost.description: What the call cost, on a call the model answered; null where nobody prices the model, which is not the same as nothing. It isn't in the cost of the tool call or step it judged.
